issue.detail: Spec says reset to 0x34; contract reset.values q=52 matches, but R1 example third vector reset=0 d=0 expects q=0, implying async clear or different reset semantics.
issue.spec_evidence: The flip-flops must be reset to 0x34 rather than zero.
issue.alternative: Reset is synchronous and only applied on negedge when reset==1; when reset==0, q captures d.
